result.stdout:
video shortcuts.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  crop                        Crop a video segment.
  speed                       Change a video segment playback speed, or apply a curve speed.
  stabilize                   Apply or disable video stabilization.
  scale                       Scale a video segment.
  rotate                      Rotate a video segment.
  translate                   Move a video segment on the canvas.
  alpha                       Set a video segment opacity.
  flip                        Flip a video segment horizontally and/or vertically.
  layer                       Set a video segment render layer.
  volume                      Set a video segment volume.
  freeze                      Freeze a frame of a video segment.
  add                         Add a video (or photo) segment to the draft.
  remove                      Remove a video segment.
                              Alias of `draft segment remove`.
  transition                  video transition shortcuts.
  filter                      video filter shortcuts.
  effect                      video effect shortcuts.
  mask                        video mask shortcuts.
  animation                   video animation shortcuts.
  beat                        video beat shortcuts.
  audio-effect                video audio-effect shortcuts.
  color                       video color shortcuts.
  adjust                      Adjust picture parameters of a video segment.
  background                  Set the background canvas of a video segment.
  matting-stroke              Apply / update / cancel matting stroke on a video or photo
                              segment.
                              Pass exactly one of --enable / --disable.
  mix-mode                    Apply / cancel PIP blend (mix) mode on a picture-in-picture video
                              segment.
                              Pass exactly one of --enable / --disable.
  face-beauty                 Apply or clear one face-beauty category, or apply one preset
                              package.
                              Pass exactly one of
                              --skin/--shape/--feature/--makeup/--body/--makeup-root/--preset.
                              Category options accept on/off/clear; --preset accepts a resource
                              URI. Use --item for semantic item keys resolved by videoeditor
                              during patch apply.
  extract-frames              Extract frame image(s) from the draft or a segment.
  extract-music               Extract music/audio from a local resource or a segment.

ACTION CHAINING
  Shared target:
    lyra-cli draft video [--ref <draft>] <selector> --action <path> <options> ...
  Per-block targets:
    lyra-cli draft video [--ref <draft>] --action <path> <selector> <options> ...
  Public selectors:
    --seg-id, --seg-type, --target-track, --seg-index, --time-window
  Rules:
    Put a shared selector before the first --action.
    Without a shared selector, every action block must declare one.
    Do not mix shared and per-block targets in one chain.
    Shortcut paths use space-separated tokens, for example `filter update`.
    Cross-object chains use `draft --action <object> <path> ...` and per-block targets.

LEARN MORE
  Use `lyra-cli draft video <subcommand> --help` for a specific shortcut.
